thread:
Priya: Quick sync — RFC follow-up on eviction scorecard + demote contract. We need a decision before next sprint so teams can build against a stable API. TL;DR: hybrid score-based eviction, explicit demote handshake, tenant credits for fairness.
Alex: Sketch please?
Priya: High-level sketch: compute a per-prefix score combining recency, request hotness, residency time, and active lease penalty. If score falls below demote_threshold -> demote flow. Hard evict only as last resort.
Jamie: Sounds ok. Curious about the active lease penalty — how do we avoid starving tenants with long leases?
Priya: Proposed: leases still win reads; we subtract a lease_penalty from score so leased prefixes are demote-resistant but not immortal. Also add "grace credits" so repeated demotes of same tenant are rate-limited.
Dan: Can you paste the score formula?
Priya: Sure:
```
score(prefix) = w_hot * hotness(prefix) + w_recency * recency_score + w_residency * residency_secs - w_lease * has_active_lease + tenant_credit(prefix)
```
where has_active_lease is 1/0, tenant_credit decays over time.
Sahil: What's hotness? QPS-ish or unique kv hits?
Priya: Hotness = moving_avg_qps * log(1 + unique_keys_accessed). We normalize per-shard.
Marta: Demote handshake pseudocode?
Priya:
```
if score(prefix) < DEMOTE_THRESHOLD:
  if try_acquire_demote_token(prefix):
    mark_prefix_demoting(prefix)
    perform_prefill_eviction_safely(prefix)
    release_demote_token(prefix)
```
Token acquisition uses sequencer to serialize demotes per-prefix.
Alex: Concern: sequencer latency -> demote stalls. Can we allow best-effort demote tokens with optional timeouts?
Priya: Yes. Token has TTL. If token acquisition fails due to contention, we backoff and re-evaluate score.
Dan: How do we handle read-after-demote races? A lot of prior bugs happened when a demote started but a read expected KV residency.
Sahil: We should keep a short demote grace: during demote the prefix stays readable; demote moves pages to cold pool and marks as demoted only after last inflight read completes.
Jamie: So we need a small inflight counter and a demote_state atomic swap. That was the safe pattern earlier.
Priya: Exactly. We'll add an inflight_reads counter and a demote_state enum {NONE, DEMOTING, DEMOTED}. Reads increment counter; demote waits for counter==0 (with timeout) before completing final step.
Marta: Metrics to watch for rollout?
Priya: Minimum set: prefix_demote_rate, demote_wait_seconds, demote_failures, avg_score_before_demote, tenant_credit_burn. Also track tail latency and 95/99 p99 for requests hitting demoted prefixes.
Alex: Testing plan?
Priya: Unit tests for score calcs + token racing tests. Integration: 1) synthetic hotkey churn harness, 2) chaos test that kills sequencer leader, 3) smoke in staging with real traffic shape.
Dan: Canary plan?
Priya: Canary in one region + 5% of traffic on Dedicated pool with metrics gating: if demote_failure_rate > 0.5% or p99 latency regresses > 10% -> rollback.
Sahil: What about fairness across tenants? Credits model details?
Priya: tenant_credit increments on soft-evict (protects tenant) and decays with half-life 30m. Credits consumed when tenant is demoted. We'll expose per-tenant credit gauge for SRE.
Jamie: Backward compatibility: does this change any client-facing API?
Priya: No API changes. It's internal eviction. We will, however, add new observability fields to the prefix metadata via telemetry (read-only).
Marta: Implementation owner and timeline?
Priya: Owners: Priya (design/coord), Alex (sequencer/tokening), Dan (runtime demote impl), Sahil (metrics + canary). Target: prototyping in 2 weeks, staging canary week 4.
Alex: One more: what about cross-shard demotes when prefix spans shards during resharding?
Priya: We'll coordinate via a global demote-tag: cross-shard demotes require all involved sequencers to acquire a shard-scoped token. Fallback is to delay demote until migration completes.
Sahil: Any perf cost for computing score on every request?
Priya: We compute hotness via sampled counters; score evaluation triggered on periodic scanner and on explicit eviction events, not per-request. Quick check: if a request touches a prefix marked candidate we bump hotness cheaply.
Dan: Security/authorization concerns? Demote tokens must be internal only.
Priya: Yes tokens are only in control plane and signed/verified. No tenant-facing surface.
Jamie: Sounds reasonable. I can start the sequencer changes after design doc lands.
Priya: I'll update the RFC with this contract and put links to the PR checklist and gating metrics.
OpsBot: Canary deploy scheduled for eng-runtime/staging at 2412345800. :rocket:
Priya: Thanks. If no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll merge design and start work. :+1:
